verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official llms.txt at docs.x.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the SpaceXAI/xAI developer documentation. The docs themselves are served as Markdown (.md URLs throughout the pack), and a machine-readable openapi.json is also published, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. The 404 probe was for a malformed double-.md URL and does not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and first-party guidance on using llms.txt with agents.
